name: DermAI Skin Lesion Benchmark Dataset (HAM10000 / ISIC aligned)
metadata_status: Verified 10,015 records in ml_dataset/HAM10000/HAM10000_metadata.csv. Both genuine empirical data and development sample_metadata.csv (1,200 synthetic records) are preserved.
domain_adaptation_note: HAM10000 is a dermoscopic dataset. For mobile smartphone screening in Milestone 2, domain adaptation (stratified augmentations or clinical mobile datasets like PAD-UFES-20) is required.

mel.name: Melanoma
mel.description: A serious form of skin cancer that begins in cells known as melanocytes.

nv.name: Melanocytic Nevus
nv.description: Common mole, benign proliferation of melanocytes.

bcc.name: Basal Cell Carcinoma
bcc.description: Most common type of skin cancer, arising from basal cells in lowest layer of epidermis.

akiec.name: Actinic Keratosis / Bowen's Disease
akiec.description: Rough, scaly patch on skin caused by years of sun exposure; potential precursor to SCC.

bkl.name: Benign Keratosis
bkl.description: Includes seborrheic keratosis, solar lentigo, and lichen-planus-like keratosis.

df.name: Dermatofibroma
df.description: Common benign cutaneous nodule consisting of fibroblasts and histiocytes.

vasc.name: Vascular Lesion
vasc.description: Includes cherry angiomas, angiokeratomas, and pyogenic granulomas.

dataset_sources.name: HAM10000 (Human Against Machine with 10000 training images)
dataset_sources.institution: ViDIR Group, Medical University of Vienna & Cliff Rosendahl Queensland
